basic_info.description: Tucked onto a quiet street in Corona Heights, 144 Lower Terrace is a beautifully polished top-floor condo in a two-unit building with a comfortable, open floor plan and generously sized rooms. Large windows, full-light doors and multiple skylights bring light into every corner of this home and offer views of the Bay and the surrounding hills from the living and dining rooms.The large, updated kitchen is highlighted by designer counters and a commercial grade Wolf range while the updated bathrooms offer a spa-like experience with natural stone or marble tile. The home features hardwoods throughout, a gas fireplace to anchor the living room for those chilly fall evenings, and access to the shared rear yard directly from the home's private deck. The attached garage offers parking and ample, dedicated storage.
